card.title: Your Turn
card.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your name's beside bathroom duty. Here's the mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this is your training opportunity.

mechanism: A transfers the mop and responsibility back to the assigned person, making demonstration conditional on accepting the task.
confusable: Unlike simply teaching cleaning, A must prevent expertise from becoming an excuse to keep the unwanted duty.
comparison: D29-a requires taking the tool before instruction; D29-b requires a public commitment before leaving the reminder group.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
